claims.claimText: UiO's student guidance presents AI as support rather than a replacement for the student's own work and tells students to show clearly when and how they used AI.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: Bruk KI som støtte, ikke som en erstatning for eget arbeid. Vis tydelig når og hvordan du har brukt KI.
evidence.evidenceSnippetDisplay: Use AI as support, not as a replacement for your own work; clearly show when and how you used AI.
evidence.snippetLocation: Grunnregler for bruk av kunstig intelligens (KI)

attribution.sourceRights: Tracker metadata is open licensed. Official source documents, page text, PDFs, and other source materials retain their original rights and terms.

claims.claimText: UiO tells students that permitted AI use varies between subjects and assignments, and that they should ask their teacher if they are unsure what is allowed.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: Reglene for bruk av kunstig intelligens (KI) vil variere mellom fag og oppgaver. Spør alltid underviseren din hvis du er usikker på hva som er tillatt.
evidence.evidenceSnippetDisplay: The rules for AI use vary between subjects and assignments; students should ask the teacher if unsure what is permitted.

attribution.sourceRights: Tracker metadata is open licensed. Official source documents, page text, PDFs, and other source materials retain their original rights and terms.

claims.claimText: UiO's teacher guidance says that when teachers allow AI use, they should provide clear AI-use guidelines and communicate academic integrity, accuracy, and source-use requirements to students.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: If you allow the use of AI Provide clear guidelines for the use of AI, and emphasize the importance of taking privacy, copyright and ethics into account Clearly communicate the requirements for academic integrity, accuracy and use of sources to the students.
evidence.snippetLocation: If you allow the use of AI

attribution.sourceRights: Tracker metadata is open licensed. Official source documents, page text, PDFs, and other source materials retain their original rights and terms.

claims.claimText: UiO describes GPT UiO as a UiO-developed service for using AI models within UiO privacy requirements, and says GPT UiO can generally be used in teaching, research, and administrative tasks with data up to yellow (limited).

evidence.evidenceSnippet: GPT UiO er en UiO-utviklet tjeneste som lar alle brukere benytte KI-modeller fra OpenAI innenfor kravene UiO setter til personvern. GPT UiO kan generelt brukes i undervisningen på UiO, til forskning og til administrative oppgaver med data opptil gult (begrenset).
evidence.evidenceSnippetDisplay: GPT UiO is a UiO-developed service for using AI models within UiO privacy requirements and can generally be used for teaching, research, and administrative tasks with data up to yellow.

attribution.sourceRights: Tracker metadata is open licensed. Official source documents, page text, PDFs, and other source materials retain their original rights and terms.

claims.claimText: UiO recommends GPT UiO or Microsoft Copilot for students because, according to the student guidance, personal data and submitted data are not shared onward and conversations are not used to train future models.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: Vi anbefaler at du bruker GPT UiO eller Microsoft Copilot, da er dataene dine trygge. Verken personopplysninger eller data du legger inn blir delt videre. Samtaler vil heller ikke bli brukt til å trene framtidige modeller.
evidence.evidenceSnippetDisplay: UiO recommends GPT UiO or Microsoft Copilot because data are safe, not shared onward, and conversations are not used to train future models.
